body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: f0fdd977c0488cb6aa4a25eae822ababbdeb146b -->

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The diff changes test fixtures, one new app test, and one decision file. No product code changed. CHANGELOG.md and the snapshot PNGs are untouched.
- The fixture keeps the seeded block inside the stock. The face now cuts 0.5 mm off the stock top, above the block. The test intent (one file per mount, its own machine and post per setup) is unchanged. Setup2's work offset follows the new stock top.
- The new test `a_face_of_a_stock_lower_than_the_part_cuts_the_part_and_never_posts` proves both halves of its name. It counts the op's `Gouge` warnings after generate. It checks the post refusal text and that no output file is written. It runs on the aligned stock and on the turned stock.
- The decision file follows docs/decisions/README.md. The heading names the issue. The entry gives the decision, the reason, what was dropped, and the later cost.

**Results**
- pr-test run 43595108060 on the self-hosted runner: success. Head f0fdd977c0488cb6aa4a25eae822ababbdeb146b on main 2b6e03f20, trial merge clean. Quick gate on the merged tree: app suites ok (26 s), ui suites ok (39 s), 0 failed. Clippy on camcraft-app and camcraft-ui: clean. https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43595108060
- The ui suites step is the green proof for #1657: the posting test passes on the merged tree.
- Mutation check, run locally in a review worktree: the reviewer removed `Face` from `is_stock_kept_kind` (crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs:89). The new test then failed: "rotated false: the face cuts the part: []" - zero gouge warnings. The test pins the Face stock-kept behaviour. The local edit was throwaway; nothing was committed.
- Test count in crates/app/tests/stock_source_law.rs: 6 before, 7 after. One test added, none removed. The Gate map header names app::operation::keep_law (is_stock_kept_kind).

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The new test runs in 0.18 s in the debug profile. It is light, so it stays out of the heavy lane.
- The tangent-edge false positive is tracked as #1659 (P3). The fixture keeps a 3 mm side spare, so this test does not depend on that fix.
- The PR body ends with the closing keyword for #1657. The merge will end that issue. Nothing else is closed by this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
